scope_summary: Expand from 8 text-only shirts to 30 products using illustrated artwork across tees, hoodies, zip hoodies, sweatshirts, long sleeves, mugs, totes, hats, beanies, sticker packs, posters, phone cases, socks, and journals. Add category filter bar. Replace text-only designs with illustrated art. No payment processing on-site; all transactions via Printful.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: Merch store with standard print-on-demand fulfillment via Printful. No subscription, no recurring billing, no PII collected on-site. Checkout and payment occur off-site on Printful's platform. Returns policy references contact page for case-by-case handling — standard for small indie stores.
evidence: No data collection beyond what Printful handles

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: Page contains no analytics, no tracking pixels, no cookies beyond what the base site already uses. Purchase data goes to Printful, not stored by Divergify. No silent exfiltration.
evidence: Static HTML with no new JS

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: Merch page. No health claims, no diagnostic language, no treatment suggestions. Product descriptions are humorous and identity-affirming, not clinical.
evidence: Product copy reviewed — no medical framing
No diagnosis or treatment language present

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: No gamification, no streaks, no countdown timers, no artificial urgency. Static product grid. Low-friction browse experience consistent with low-stim design principles.
evidence: No dark patterns in product copy

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: Designs are explicitly low-sensory: muted palettes, clean prints, no loud graphics. Product descriptions use grounded, non-pathologizing language consistent with ND dignity principles. Grid layout is predictable and scannable.
evidence: No flashing elements or animated distractions
Product copy reviewed for shame-free framing

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Merch store funds continued Divergify development. Purchasing is entirely optional. No psychological coercion. Clear pricing, no hidden fees on our end (Printful's base costs are standard). Benefit: revenue that keeps the build alive. Foreseeable harm: none beyond a customer not liking a shirt.

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Product descriptions reviewed for Takota voice: blunt, grounded, no wellness fluff, no fake urgency. Mission copy is honest about the indie/ND founder context. No unsubstantiated product claims.
evidence: No 'this will fix your ADHD' framing

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: All product images have descriptive alt text. Buy buttons are keyboard-accessible anchor tags with visible focus states inherited from global.css. Product names are in h2 tags for screen reader hierarchy. Color contrast meets WCAG AA (gold on near-black). No auto-play, no motion.
evidence: alt attributes present on all 9 product images
Semantic h2 headings on product names
Buttons are <a> tags with button class — no JS required to use

security_and_reliability.rationale: Static HTML file with no new JS, no form submissions, no API calls originating from our domain. External links use target=_blank with rel=noopener. No new attack surface introduced.

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: Transparent pricing shown before any click-through. No upsells, no countdown timers, no FOMO copy, no forced account creation. Buy buttons open Printful product page in new tab — user remains in full control. Monetization model (merch funding dev) is explicitly stated on the page.
evidence: Mission section explains why store exists
All links open in new tab, not forced redirect

ship_decision.conditions: All filters clear. One outstanding action item post-ship: replace href='#' placeholder buy button URLs with real Printful Store product URLs once Printful Store is enabled.
